tagline.zh: 判讀室的黑暗、CT 的一通電話、磁場區的髮夾
tagline.en: The dark of the reading room, a call from CT, a hairpin at the magnet door

desc.zh: 跟著羅主治判讀、量病灶、做床邊超音波、打危急發現的電話。
desc.en: Read with Dr Lo, measure lesions, scan at the bedside and make the critical-finding call.

desc.zh: 擺位、掃描、MRI 安全篩檢與急救車的位置都在你手上。磁場區是你守的。
desc.en: Positioning, scanning, MRI safety screening and knowing where the crash cart is are yours. You guard the magnet zone.

about.zh: 在黑暗裡用三台螢幕看世界。保溫瓶永遠是空的，但他堅持帶著。
about.en: Sees the world through three monitors in the dark. His thermos is always empty, but he insists on bringing it.

about.zh: 管顯影劑、靜脈留置針和急救車。她說：打之前先知道車在哪。
about.en: Runs the contrast, the cannulas and the crash cart. Her rule: know where the cart is before you inject.

role.zh: 顯影 CT，單上寫「顯影劑過敏」
role.en: Contrast CT; the form says “contrast allergy”

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。退休老師，隨身一本寫滿問題的筆記本。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. A retired teacher with a notebook full of questions.

role.zh: MRI，體內有不明型號植入物

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。緊張就唱歌。頭上有一支媽媽留下的髮夾。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Sings when nervous. Wears a hairpin her mother left her.

about.zh: 推床推了二十年，知道每一台咖啡機在哪裡。
about.en: Twenty years of pushing trolleys. Knows where every coffee machine in the hospital is.

about.zh: 電話開頭永遠是「我要一個 CT」。後來學會先說問題。
about.en: Every call starts with “I need a CT”. By evening he has learned to start with the question.

about.zh: 接危急發現電話的人。他會複誦。
about.en: The one who takes the critical-finding call. He reads back.

plain.zh: 醫院的影像儲存與傳輸系統，所有片子都在裡面，可以和舊片並排比較。
plain.en: The hospital's picture archiving system; every image lives there and can be compared side by side with old ones.

plain.zh: X 光從哪個方向穿過身體：站著後前位或躺著前後位，心臟看起來的大小會不同。
plain.en: Which way the X-ray beam passes through the body: standing back-to-front or lying front-to-back changes how big the heart looks.

plain.zh: 拍胸片時沒有吸飽氣，肺看起來比較白、心臟比較大，容易被誤認為病變。
plain.en: Not breathing in fully for a chest film makes the lungs look whiter and the heart larger, mimicking disease.

plain.zh: 注射進血管讓血管和器官在影像上變亮的藥劑；少數人會過敏。
plain.en: A liquid injected into a vein that brightens vessels and organs on the scan; a few people react to it.

plain.zh: 皮膚突然冒出會癢的紅疹塊，是過敏反應的常見早期表現。
plain.en: Itchy raised red weals that appear suddenly; a common early sign of an allergic reaction.

plain.zh: 夾在手指上的感測器讀出血液帶氧的比例；往下掉就是呼吸或循環出了問題。
plain.en: The finger-clip reading of how much oxygen the blood carries; a fall means breathing or circulation is in trouble.

plain.zh: 用聲波看體內，沒有輻射，可以推到床邊做。
plain.en: Imaging with sound waves, no radiation, and the machine can be wheeled to the bedside.

plain.zh: 病灶最長的那一條線；短軸與它垂直。追蹤要用同一個切面量。
plain.en: The longest line across a lesion; the short axis is perpendicular to it. Follow-up measurements use the same slice.

plain.zh: MRI 磁鐵周圍的管制區，任何鐵磁性物品都會被吸飛，進門前要篩檢。
plain.en: The controlled area around the MRI magnet; anything ferromagnetic becomes a projectile, so everyone is screened at the door.

plain.zh: 放在體內的金屬或裝置，如骨釘、心臟節律器；做 MRI 前要有文件證明安全。
plain.en: A metal or electronic device inside the body, such as bone screws or a pacemaker; MRI needs documents proving it is safe.

plain.zh: 影像上看到可能立刻危及生命的東西，放射科醫師必須直接打電話告知臨床醫師。
plain.en: Something on the images that may be immediately life-threatening; the radiologist must telephone the clinician directly.

plain.zh: 接電話的人把病人、檢查與發現重複一遍，確認聽對了。
plain.en: The person taking the call repeats the patient, the study and the finding to confirm it was heard correctly.

plain.zh: CT 的一種顯示設定，讓骨頭的細節清楚，用來找骨折。
plain.en: A CT display setting that brings out bone detail, used to find fractures.

plain.zh: 腦部 CT 上左右中線被推歪，代表一側有東西在壓迫。
plain.en: On a head CT, the midline pushed to one side, meaning something is pressing from the other.

text.zh: 三台螢幕、一支口述麥克風。先核對姓名、日期、左右，再開始看。
text.en: Three monitors and a dictation mic. Check name, date and side before you look at anything else.

text.zh: 掃描範圍、呼吸指令、顯影劑時相都在這裡設定。本站不提供參數。
text.en: Scan range, breathing commands and contrast timing are set here. No parameters are given on this site.

text.zh: 磁場永遠開著，即使半夜。氧氣瓶、輪椅、髮夾都飛過。
text.en: The field is always on, even at midnight. Oxygen cylinders, wheelchairs and hairpins have all flown.

text.zh: 最後一道防線，不是第一道。問卷與文件在它前面。
text.en: The last line of defence, not the first. The questionnaire and the documents come before it.

text.zh: 打顯影劑之前先知道它在哪裡。封條完整、每日檢查。
text.en: Know where it is before any contrast injection. Seal intact, checked daily.

text.zh: 注射中有人在旁邊看病人，不是只看螢幕。
text.en: Someone watches the patient during injection, not just the screen.

text.zh: 阿梅姨媽媽留下的。在磁場區門口被攔下來，檢查後完璧歸趙。
text.en: Left to Auntie Mei by her mother. Stopped at the magnet zone door and returned after the scan.

text.zh: 直接電話、對方複誦、記錄時間與姓名、報告註明。四步都要。
text.en: Direct call, read-back, time and names recorded, noted in the report. All four.

text.zh: 從候診到磁鐵室分四區，越靠近磁鐵管制越嚴；第四區只有篩檢過的人和物。
text.en: Four zones from the waiting area to the magnet room, tighter with every step; zone four admits only screened people and objects.

note.en: Morning reads: check the projection first

lines.zh: 判讀室很暗，三台螢幕亮著。羅主治的保溫瓶放在旁邊，空的。
lines.en: The reading room is dark; three monitors glow. Dr Lo's thermos sits beside them, empty.

lines.zh: 早。昨晚的胸片，同一個人兩張，看起來不一樣。你先看哪裡？
lines.en: Morning. Two chest films from last night, same patient, and they look different. Where do you look first?

lines.zh: 先看拍攝資訊：日期、身分、投照方式。
lines.en: The acquisition details first: date, identity, projection.

lines.zh: 在 PACS 上做給我看。
lines.en: Show me on PACS.

post.zh: 先核對，再比較。影像不會自己告訴你它是怎麼拍的。
post.en: Verify, then compare. An image never volunteers how it was taken.

guide.en: Compare the two films at the lightbox

lines.zh: 來，兩張並排。為什麼這張心臟看起來比較大？
lines.en: Side by side. Why does the heart look bigger on this one?

question.zh: 同一個人的兩張胸片，為什麼一張的心臟看起來比較大？
question.en: Two chest films of the same person: why does the heart look bigger on one?

answer.zh: 躺著的前後投照與吸氣不足都會放大心影、讓肺野變白。先看投照方式與吸氣深度，再判斷是不是真的變化。
answer.en: A supine front-to-back projection and poor inspiration both magnify the heart and whiten the lungs. Check the projection and the depth of breath before calling it a real change.

post.zh: 技術差異要寫進報告的限制，不然臨床會當成惡化。
post.en: Technical differences go into the report's limitations, or the ward will read it as deterioration.

note.zh: 一個過敏標籤變成一段病史
note.en: An allergy label became a history

guide.zh: 去 CT 室看江先生

lines.zh: 江老師到。他的問題比我的早餐還多。
lines.en: Mr Jiang, delivered. He has more questions than I have breakfast.

lines.zh: 醫師，單上寫我對顯影劑過敏。可是我也不確定那次是什麼。
lines.en: Doctor, the form says I'm allergic to contrast medium. But I'm not sure myself what happened that time.

lines.zh: 單子只寫「顯影劑過敏」，沒有時間、沒有症狀、沒有產品。
lines.en: The form just says “contrast allergy”. No date, no symptoms, no product.

q.zh: 檢查單只有一個過敏標籤，你怎麼做？
q.en: The request has one allergy label and nothing else. What do you do?

options.zh: 補問反應細節與時間，交放射科醫師決定
options.en: Ask for the reaction details and timing; the radiologist decides

why.zh: 標籤不是病史。反應是什麼、多嚴重、哪種產品，決定一切。
why.en: A label is not a history. What the reaction was, how severe, and which product decide everything.

why.zh: 臨床問題還在。取消也要有理由。
why.en: The clinical question still stands. Even cancelling needs a reason.

options.en: Inject as usual, everyone writes that

why.zh: 不知道上次是什麼反應，就不能說這次安全。
why.en: Not knowing the last reaction means you cannot call this one safe.

post.zh: 那次是在別家醫院做別的檢查，起了一點疹子，沒喘。
post.en: It was at another hospital, a different test. A bit of a rash, no breathing trouble.

post.zh: 別家、別的檢查、輕度皮膚反應。依規範準備，觀察時間拉長，急救車在旁。
post.en: Different hospital, different study, mild skin reaction. Prepare per protocol, extend the observation, cart at hand.

guide.en: Locate the crash cart before injecting

lines.zh: 打之前，先知道車在哪。
lines.en: Before you inject, know where the cart is.

lines.zh: 江老師，雙手舉過頭，等一下聽指令吸氣憋住。我先去確認一樣東西。
lines.en: Mr Jiang, arms above your head; in a moment you'll hear the breath-hold command. I need to check one thing first.

post.en: Seal intact. Right, we can start.

lines.zh: 江先生的肝臟追蹤病灶。量長軸與垂直短軸，和上次同一個切面。
lines.en: Mr Jiang's liver lesion on follow-up. Long axis and perpendicular short axis, on the same slice as last time.

post.zh: 同一切面、同一視窗，數字才能比。
post.en: Same slice, same window, or the numbers cannot be compared.

guide.en: Take the ER call at the desk

lines.zh: 喂，影像科嗎？我要排一個 CT，病人痛。
lines.en: Hello, radiology? I need to book a CT, the patient's in pain.

lines.zh: 哪裡痛、多久了？你希望影像回答什麼問題？
lines.en: Where, and for how long? What question do you want the imaging to answer?

lines.zh: ……等我一下。
lines.en: …hang on.

lines.zh: 沒有問題，就沒有正確的檢查。
lines.en: Without a question there is no right test.

post.zh: 右上腹痛三天、發燒。問題是膽道有沒有阻塞。
post.en: Right upper quadrant pain for three days, fever. The question is whether the bile duct is blocked.

post.zh: 那先超音波，CT 不一定是第一步。推過來，我們一起看。
post.en: Then ultrasound first; CT is not necessarily step one. Bring him over and we'll look together.

lines.zh: 急診的到了。順便說，三樓的咖啡機修好了。
lines.en: The ER patient's here. Also, the third-floor coffee machine is fixed.

lines.zh: 探頭方向標記朝頭側。先找到病灶，再說話。
lines.en: Probe marker towards the head. Find the lesion first, then talk.

post.zh: 找到了就描述它：位置、大小、邊緣、後方。不要先寫診斷。
post.en: Once found, describe it: site, size, margin, what lies behind. No diagnosis yet.

note.zh: 植入物沒有文件，就不猜
note.en: No implant documents means no guessing

guide.zh: 去 MRI 候診區看阿梅姨
guide.en: See Auntie Mei in the MRI waiting area

lines.zh: 阿梅姨在候診區小聲唱歌。她緊張就唱。
lines.en: Auntie Mei is singing softly in the waiting area. She sings when she is nervous.

lines.zh: 醫師，我身體裡有一片鐵，什麼牌子我不知道。做 MRI 會不會飛出來？
lines.en: Doctor, I've got a bit of metal inside me, no idea what make. Will the MRI pull it out?

lines.zh: 阿梅姨，沒有文件以前，我們不猜。植入物要查清楚。
lines.en: Auntie Mei, until we have the documents we don't guess. The implant has to be identified.

post.zh: MRI 安全由安全團隊核實，不靠記憶，也不靠外觀。
post.en: MRI safety is verified by the safety team, not from memory or appearance.

lines.zh: 阿梅姨，進磁場區前我們一步一步來。
lines.en: Auntie Mei, before the magnet zone we go step by step.

steps.en: Complete the safety questionnaire item by item

steps.zh: 移除所有金屬物品、更衣
steps.en: Remove all metal objects and change

steps.zh: 植入物文件由安全團隊核實
steps.en: Implant documents verified by the safety team
Final check before entering the magnet zone

post.zh: 金屬探測門響了。阿梅姨頭上的髮夾。
post.en: The metal detector sounds. Auntie Mei's hairpin.

lines.zh: 那支髮夾是我媽留給我的！
lines.en: That hairpin was my mother's!

lines.zh: 會還您，只是不能進磁場區。我幫您收好。
lines.en: You'll get it back; it just cannot go into the magnet zone. I'll keep it safe.

lines.zh: 還有，那個管子很窄，我會怕。
lines.en: And that tube is so narrow. I get scared.

lines.zh: 耳機、鏡子、手上的呼叫球，門外有人陪。您可以唱歌。
lines.en: Headphones, a mirror, a call ball in your hand, someone just outside. And you can sing.

lines.zh: 後來整個 MRI 室都聽到她唱完了兩首歌。文件也到了：植入物可以安全掃描。
lines.en: Later the whole MRI suite hears her finish two songs. The documents arrive too: the implant is safe to scan.

note.zh: 危急發現：直接電話、複誦、記錄
note.en: Critical finding: direct call, read-back, record

guide.zh: 回 PACS 看剛做完的 CT
guide.en: Back to PACS for the fresh CT

lines.zh: 剛做完的胸部 CT。看這裡。
lines.en: The chest CT that just finished. Look here.

lines.zh: 肺動脈裡有一個不該在那裡的充填缺損。
lines.en: There is a filling defect in a pulmonary artery that should not be there.

lines.zh: 危急發現。報告可以等五分鐘，病房不能。接下來？
lines.en: Critical finding. The report can wait five minutes; the ward cannot. Next?

steps.zh: 確認接聽者與病人身分
steps.en: Confirm who is answering and the patient's identity
State the study and the key finding
Record the time, the person and what was said
Note the notification in the report

post.zh: 影像科。你的病人胸部 CT 有危急發現，肺動脈充填缺損。請複誦。
post.en: Radiology. Your patient's chest CT has a critical finding, a pulmonary artery filling defect. Please read back.

post.zh: 複誦：胸部 CT，肺動脈充填缺損，我現在去看病人。
post.en: Read-back: chest CT, pulmonary artery filling defect. I'm going to the patient now.
Time and name, into the report.

note.zh: 江先生的反應：人、藥、車都在
note.en: Mr Jiang reacts: people, drugs and cart ready

sub.zh: 江先生打完顯影劑，臉紅、喘
sub.en: Mr Jiang after contrast: flushed and short of breath

lines.zh: 注射後幾分鐘，臉紅、蕁麻疹，開始喘。血氧往下掉。
lines.en: A few minutes after the injection: flushing, urticaria, now wheezy. Oxygen saturation is dropping.

lines.zh: 我……喉嚨緊。
lines.en: My… throat feels tight.

options.zh: 停注射、叫人、依醫囑給氧、急救車到旁
options.en: Stop the injection, call for help, oxygen per order, cart to the bedside

why.zh: 中重度反應：人、氧氣、急救車同時到，主治到場依規範處置。
why.en: A moderate to severe reaction: people, oxygen and the cart arrive together; the attending treats per protocol.

why.zh: 影像可以重做，呼吸道不能等。
why.en: A scan can be repeated. An airway cannot wait.

options.zh: 請他深呼吸，等一下看看
options.en: Ask him to breathe deeply and wait

why.zh: 喉嚨緊加血氧下降，不是等得起的組合。
why.en: A tight throat plus falling saturation is not a combination that waits.

post.zh: 主治到了，依醫囑處置中。血氧回來了。
post.en: The attending's here, treating per order. Saturation is coming back.

lines.zh: 你早上問過了。我們知道他上次是輕度皮膚反應，所以人、藥、車先備好，觀察時間也拉長。
lines.en: You asked this morning. We knew his last reaction was mild skin, so people, drugs and cart were ready and the observation was extended.

lines.zh: ……我的筆記本上又多一個問題。
lines.en: …That's another question for my notebook.

lines.zh: 沒有人知道他上次是什麼反應。今天我們是沒有地圖在開車。
lines.en: Nobody knew what his last reaction was. Today we drove without a map.

lines.zh: 我早上應該問清楚的。
lines.en: I should have asked properly this morning.

lines.zh: 是。下次你會。
lines.en: Yes. Next time you will.

guide.en: The three things after a reaction

lines.zh: 處理完還有三件事：記錄、通報、寫進過敏史，寫清楚是什麼反應、哪種顯影劑。
lines.en: After treating, three more things: document, report, and write it into his allergy history with the reaction and the exact contrast medium.

lines.zh: 下次不會再只剩一個標籤了。
lines.en: Next time it won't be just a label.

note.zh: 交班：未報告、已通知、觀察中

lines.zh: 交班：三個未報告的檢查、一個已通知的危急發現、江先生觀察中。
lines.en: Handover: three studies unreported, one critical finding notified, Mr Jiang under observation.

lines.zh: 今天四件事都不是影像本身：投照、標籤、問題、文件。
lines.en: None of today's four lessons was the image itself: projection, label, question, documents.

lines.zh: 影像回答問題。沒有問題，它就只是一張照片。
lines.en: Imaging answers questions. Without a question it is just a photograph.

lines.zh: 他拿起保溫瓶，搖了搖。還是空的。
lines.en: He picks up the thermos and shakes it. Still empty.

lines.zh: 三樓的咖啡機修好了，我說過了。
lines.en: Third-floor coffee machine's fixed. I did say.

note.zh: 夜裡的頭部 CT：出血、中線、骨窗
note.en: Night head CT: bleed, midline, bone window

guide.zh: 回 PACS 判讀急診 CT
guide.en: Read the ER CT on PACS

sub.zh: 機車車禍，頭部 CT 做完了，請判讀
sub.en: Motorbike crash, head CT done, please read

lines.zh: 機車車禍，頭部 CT 剛做完。問題：有沒有出血、要不要叫神外。
lines.en: Motorbike crash, head CT just finished. Question: is there a bleed, and do I call neurosurgery?

lines.zh: 你學會先說問題了。
lines.en: You've learned to lead with the question.

lines.zh: 白天被你電過。
lines.en: You drilled it into me this morning.

question.zh: 外傷頭部 CT 先看什麼？
question.en: What do you look at first on a trauma head CT?

answer.zh: 先看有沒有出血與中線偏移，再用骨窗看骨折；每一個視窗各看一次，不要只看一種。
answer.en: First any bleed and any midline shift, then the bone window for fractures; look through every window once, never just one.

post.zh: 口頭先給：無出血、無中線偏移、骨窗再確認一次。書面馬上出。
post.en: Verbal first: no bleed, no midline shift, bone window to be re-checked. Written report follows now.

post.zh: 複誦：無出血、無中線偏移、骨窗再看。謝了。
post.en: Read-back: no bleed, no midline shift, bone window pending. Thanks.

post.zh: 判讀室又安靜下來。三台螢幕，一個空保溫瓶，和一支還給阿梅姨的髮夾留下的回憶。
post.en: The reading room goes quiet again. Three monitors, an empty thermos, and the memory of a hairpin returned to Auntie Mei.

sub.zh: 影像回答問題；沒有問題就只是照片
sub.en: Imaging answers questions; without one it is just a photo
